_comment: Per-unit overrides on top of data/bsdata/parsed.json. Each entry can partially override any field (health, damage, hit_probability, ap, save, name, enabled, notes). Standalone entries listed here that don't exist in parsed.json become fully hand-rolled units; they must specify all required fields.

chaos_knights_library_knight_desecrator.notes: SC5-2: Chaos Knight chassis carry a 5+ invulnerable save (Ion Shield) on their datasheet, but the BSData Chaos Knights Library cache has no Invulnerable Save infoLink attached to any Chaos Knight selectionEntry (verified via grep over Chaos - Chaos Knights Library.cat.gz: zero infoLinks named 'Invulnerable Save'). Same omission pattern as necrons_doomsday_ark / aeldari_wraithguard — the rule exists on the printed datasheet but is not encoded in BSData. Source: 10e Chaos Knights codex Ion Shield (5+ invulnerable save against ranged and melee attacks). Wahapedia unreachable from worktree DNS; restoring the missing invuln per BSData omission precedent.

necrons_necron_warriors.notes: 10e Necron Warriors carry the Their Number Is Legion rule — they have OC equal to a normal infantryman PLUS hold objectives even after leaving them. Sourced from wahapedia.ru Necrons datasheet. | Range left at mapper-selected 12" (Gauss Reaper) — Gauss Flayer 24" is the alternate wargear, both valid; not a mapper bug.

necrons_doomsday_ark.notes: DDA diag (sim-cal-4): Doomsday Ark carries a 4+ invulnerable save on its datasheet but the BSData mapper missed it. The invuln is stored as a local profile under the unit entry (typeName="Abilities", name="Invulnerable Save", Description "This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.") rather than as an infoLink, and code/bsdata/mapper.py:extract_invuln only scans infoLinks. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/necrons/#Doomsday-Ark (Invulnerable Save 4+). Stats T9 W14 Sv3+ and Doomsday Cannon profile 72" D6+1 shots S18 AP-4 D4 Blast Heavy match BSData and Wahapedia.

necrons_canoptek_doomstalker.notes: DDA diag (sim-cal-4): Canoptek Doomstalker carries a 4+ invulnerable save on its datasheet but the BSData mapper missed it for the same reason as necrons_doomsday_ark — local Abilities profile, not an infoLink. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/necrons/#Canoptek-Doomstalker (Invulnerable Save 4+). Stats T8 W12 Sv3+ and Doomsday Blaster profile 48" D6+1 shots S14 AP-3 D3 Blast Heavy match BSData.

BSData does not encode the Markerlight keyword as a unit-level tag — it lives on the weapon entry — so we surface it here. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Pathfinder-Team and the army-rule https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Markerlights

Add MARKERLIGHT keyword so the simulator's _run_markerlight_phase counts the squad as a marker carrier. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Stealth-Battlesuits and the army-rule https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/t-au-empire/#Markerlights

adeptus_custodes_custodian_wardens.notes: iter24 Custodian Wardens fix bundle. The Wardens Living Fortress once-per-battle FNP 4+ is NOT modelled here — SwegHammer has no once-per-phase phase-scoped FNP buff layer. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/#Custodian-Wardens

aeldari_drukhari_wyches.notes: SC5-8: BSData attaches a static Feel No Pain 5+ infoLink to every Drukhari unit alongside the Power from Pain rule. Power From Pain (10e Drukhari army rule) is conditional: a unit only gains Feel No Pain 6+ while holding a Pain Token (awarded each Command phase to units Below Starting Strength). The simulator already implements the conditional rule in code/units.py (line 668: 'if self.pain_tokens > 0 and self.profile.faction == Drukhari: effective_fnp = min(effective_fnp, 6)'). Baking fnp=5 into the static profile double-counts: it gives every Drukhari unit a permanent Feel No Pain 5+ that ignores the Pain Token gate AND is stronger than the rule actually grants (6+ vs 5+). Reset to 7 (no static Feel No Pain) and let the runtime Power From Pain handle FNP 6+ conditionally. Source: 10e Drukhari codex Power From Pain (Wahapedia: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/drukhari/#Power-from-Pain).

tyranids_winged_tyranid_prime.notes: SC5-10: cleared static Feel No Pain 5+ fabricated by the BSData prose-walk FNP extractor (code/bsdata/mapper.py:extract_fnp) pulling 'Feel No Pain 5+' text out of the Tyranid 'Adaptive Biology' Enhancement in Library - Tyranids.cat. Adaptive Biology is a single-CHARACTER, Below-Starting-Wounds-gated enhancement ("The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability"), not a datasheet ability — applying it as always-on to every Tyranid CHARACTER + MONSTER datasheet double-counts and over-models. Winged Tyranid Prime has no native Feel No Pain. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/tyranids/#Winged-Tyranid-Prime

adeptus_custodes_venatari_custodians.notes: AK-2: Venatari Custodians charge with Interceptor Lance, a melee weapon carrying the [LANCE] keyword (BSData 'Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.cat.gz' profile name='Interceptor lance' typeName='Melee Weapons' with Keywords='Lance'). The mapper's basket-weight aggregation drops Lance below the 50% majority because the model's secondary Kinetic Destroyer ranged shots dilute the melee basket; restore the keyword via override. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/#Venatari-Custodians

aeldari_craftworlds_skyweavers.notes: AK-2: Skyweavers' Haywire Cannon carries [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] and Devastating Wounds (BSData 'Aeldari - Aeldari Library.cat.gz' profile name='Skyweaver Haywire Cannon' typeName='Ranged Weapons' Keywords='Anti-Vehicle 4+, Devastating Wounds'). The mapper drops it because the alternate Shuriken Cannon loadout dilutes the basket. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/aeldari/#Skyweavers

aeldari_drukhari_scourges.notes: AK-2: Scourges' Haywire Blaster carries [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] and Devastating Wounds (BSData 'Aeldari - Aeldari Library.cat.gz' profile name='Haywire Blaster' typeName='Ranged Weapons' Keywords='Anti-Vehicle 4+, Devastating Wounds, Heavy'). Mapper drops it because Scourges field five models with a mixed pool of special weapons; the anti-vehicle blaster never reaches a 50% basket majority. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/drukhari/#Scourges

imperial_knights_library_questoris_knigh.notes: AK-2: Knight Styrix carries a Graviton Crusher with [ANTI-VEHICLE 2+] and Blast (BSData 'Imperium - Imperial Knights - Library.cat.gz' profile name='Graviton crusher' typeName='Ranged Weapons' Keywords='Anti-Vehicle 2+, Blast'). The mapper kept secondary_anti_keywords={'VEHICLE':2} but lost the primary tag when other weapon profiles outweighed the crusher in the primary basket. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/imperial-knights/#Knight-Styrix

chaos_knights_library_chaos_questoris_kn.notes: AK-2: Chaos Knight Styrix mirrors Imperial Knight Styrix — Graviton Crusher [ANTI-VEHICLE 2+, Blast] in BSData 'Chaos - Chaos Knights Library.cat.gz'. Same basket-dilution miss; surface the keyword via override. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/chaos-knights/#Knight-Styrix

tyranids_raveners.notes: AK-2: Raveners' Ravener Heavy Claws and Talons carry [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 5+] with Twin-linked (BSData 'Library - Tyranids.cat.gz' profile name='Ravener heavy claws and talons' typeName='Melee Weapons' Keywords='Anti-Monster 5+, Anti-Vehicle 5+, Twin-linked'). The keyword pair is the unit's anti-titan answer; basket aggregation lost it because the alternate Spinemaws ranged profile dominates the secondary basket. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/tyranids/#Raveners

orks_beast_snagga_boyz.notes: AK-2: Beast Snagga Boyz wield Beast Snagga Klaws with [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] (BSData 'Orks.cat.gz' profile name='Beast Snagga klaw' typeName='Melee Weapons' Keywords='Anti-Monster 4+, Anti-Vehicle 4+'). Squad of ten with one or two big-choppa special models causes the klaw to fall below 50% basket weight in the mapper. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/orks/#Beast-Snagga-Boyz

orks_kill_rig.notes: AK-2: Kill Rig packs a Stikka Kannon with [ANTI-MONSTER 2+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 2+] (BSData 'Orks.cat.gz' profile name='Stikka kannon' typeName='Ranged Weapons' Keywords='Anti-Monster 2+, Anti-Vehicle 2+, Snagged'). It also carries Tusks plus Wurrtower [ANTI-MONSTER 4+ / ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] crew weapons on the secondary basket — restore both. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/orks/#Kill-Rig

orks_warbikers.notes: AK-2: Warbikers carry Power Stabba melee weapons keyworded [LANCE] (BSData 'Orks.cat.gz' profile name='Power stabba' typeName='Melee Weapons' Keywords='Lance'). Wahapedia confirms the +1 to wound on the charge for the stabba profile. Mapper drops the keyword because the bike's Dakkagun ranged profiles dominate the basket weight and the squad has only three models. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/orks/#Warbikers

orks_squiggoth_legends.notes: AK-2: Squiggoth's Huge Tusks melee profile is keyworded [LANCE] (BSData 'Orks.cat.gz' profile name='Huge tusks' typeName='Melee Weapons' Keywords='Lance' — the strike-mode tusks). Restoring the trample-on-charge bonus per Wahapedia. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/orks/#Squiggoth

imperial_knights_library_armiger_moirax.notes: AK-2: Armiger Moirax already shows primary anti_keywords={'VEHICLE':2} from its Lightning Lock / Volkite combo. Mirror the secondary tag so the unit's swappable Graviton-Pulsar / Siege Claw loadout (BSData 'Imperium - Imperial Knights - Library.cat.gz' profile name='Graviton pulsar' Keywords='Anti-Vehicle 2+, Blast') keeps anti-VEHICLE coverage when the simulator selects the secondary basket. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/imperial-knights/#Armiger-Moirax
